description: Fix CELL 2 model download section: replace broken HuggingFace URLs (KIJAI_23 base URL pointing to non-existent repo) with correct repositories and add multi-URL fallback mechanism with improved error reporting.
steps: Modify _dl() to capture and display both stdout and stderr in error messages
Add _dl_multi() helper that accepts a list of URLs and tries each in sequence
Update all download calls with correct HuggingFace repository URLs and fallbacks
acceptance_criteria: _dl() reports both stdout and stderr on failure
_dl_multi() exists and tries URLs in order with proper fallback
All download URLs use verified HuggingFace repositories
